description: This Python source file defines classes and functions related to invoking and transforming Anthropic Claude models via Bedrock API in a project that handles large language models (LLMs). It includes a configuration class for Claude model invocation, streaming response handling, request transformation, and decoder logic for Bedrock's generic event stream data.
